#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding:utf-8 -*-
# Launcher for {bin}, generated by package_creator. Runs on every call: keep it minimal.
import os
import sys


def {func_name}():
    exe = os.path.join(
        os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "{gcc_folder}", "bin", "{bin}"
    )
    argv = [exe] + sys.argv[1:]
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        # Replace this process so signals and the exit code reach the tool directly
        os.execv(exe, argv)
    # Windows cannot exec: run the tool as a child and forward its exit code
    import subprocess

    process = subprocess.Popen(argv)
    while True:
        try:
            return process.wait()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass  # The child got the same Ctrl+C, let it decide what to do


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit({func_name}())
